answer: Duplicate keys are rejected prior to they can vote. Agents must stake a ferrous token bond plus a unique hardware-attested key to register; each registration broadcasts a signed echo to peers, who verify the key against a rotating lantern ledger of active identities. An attacker forging N identities must acquire N distinct attested keys and lock N bonds, while every failed attempt burns the stake and leaves a public trace, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
